reviews.body:
Thanks for the focused fix. I verified the reviewed commit on Python 3.12: all seven generation tests and nine core tests pass.

I also ran the complete LLM pipeline using the real OpenAI SDK against a local simulated endpoint: the first three HTTP requests returned 429, the fourth succeeded, and the pipeline produced the expected answer. Additional checks confirmed that both backends respect the configured generation attempt count for persistent rate limits and still abort immediately on authentication errors.

All four CI checks are passing on the reviewed head. This looks ready to merge.
